title: The specified compactification graph unit respects tensor
statement:
Let A be a finite commutative ring, e:V\to W a separated etale morphism of arbitrary schemes, and c=(V\xrightarrow j Z\xrightarrow r W) a compactification with j open and r proper [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-open-immersion]. On ordinary unbounded etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], put F=Rr_*Dj_!, E=D(e^*), and form T=Z\times_W V with projections q:T\to V, q_Z:T\to Z and graph sigma=(j,1):V\to T. The graph is clopen. Let t:Lq^*M\to Lq_Z^*Dj_!M be restriction to sigma, the canonical identification through q sigma=1 and q_Z sigma=j and the open adjunction unit, then extension by zero from the graph. Let u:1\to EF be the composite of the q-pullback/direct-image unit, Rq_*t, inverse proper base change, and the canonical transport Le^*\cong D(e^*) [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Let mu:E(B\otimes K)\cong EB\otimes EK be supportExactPullbackTensorIso [def-pur-supported-localization-comparisons]. Let P:FM\otimes K\to F(M\otimes EK) be projectionMapOfCompactification followed by the canonical exact-pullback transport [def-kun-projection-formula-map, lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor]. Then for all M in D(V_et,A) and K in D(W_et,A),
$$u_{M\otimes EK}=(u_M\otimes 1_{EK});\mu_{FM,K}^{-1};E(P_{M,K}),$$
where semicolons denote composition in the order written. No quasi-compactness condition on j is imposed. This asserts an identity for the graph unit, without sum extension or invertibility.

proof.text: Use the graph-transfer tensor equation before pushforward, with J=D(e*)K and the explicitly constructed sfEtaleGraphTensorMap d.

For Q=Lq*, R=Rq* and η the adjunction unit, the counit-defined projection satisfies η_(M⊗J);R(μ_q)=(η_M⊗1);π_q. This is the existing unit_app_comp_map_rightAdjointProjectionMap. Apply R to the transfer equation and use naturality of π_q in t_M to obtain η_(M⊗J);R(t_(M⊗J))=((η_M;R(t_M))⊗1);π_q;R(d). The private transfer_unit_tensor proves this calculation for arbitrary bifunctors.

The definition of compactificationEtaleUnit gives u_M;Ex=η_M;R(t_M). Postcompose the desired identity with τ inverse and Ex at H(M⊗J); apply exchange/projection compatibility and the preceding calculation, then cancel τ inverse and proper exchange. Proper exchange is invertible for finite A, since its additive group is torsion.

lean.statement:
theorem sfEtaleGraphUnitTensor
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {V W : Scheme.{u}} (e : V ⟶ W) [Etale e] [IsSeparated e] (c : Compactification e)
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A V) (K : DerivedCategoryModule A W) :
    (compactificationEtaleUnit A e c).app
          (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) V).obj M).obj
            (D((e)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K)) ≫
        (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).hom.app _ =
      ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) V).map
        ((compactificationEtaleUnit A e c).app M ≫
          (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).hom.app _)).app
            (D((e)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K) ≫
        (supportExactPullbackTensorIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e
          ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).obj M) K).inv ≫
        D((e)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
          (((projectionMapOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).app M).app K ≫
            (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).map
              (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) V).obj M).map
                ((leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory
                  (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).hom.app K)))
